notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Turn a business decision into a useful research conversation.
intro: A proposed GTM workbench for Strella: connect research-buyer signals to a clear decision, the right relationship owner and an appropriate next conversation.
queueIntro: All organizations and research needs are fictional. No participant transcripts, private interview responses or personal research data are used.
workbenchIntro: Review who buys the research, what decision it informs and whether sales or CS owns the relationship. A signal is a discovery prompt, not a validated insight.
firstBuild: A research-decision brief that survives the handoff
firstBody: Attach the buyer’s decision, timing, evidence and existing relationship to the account so sales and CS can ask a relevant question.

fields.label: Research buyer distinguished from interview participant
Business research decision and timing recorded
Buying signal has a dated source
Research method and support needs kept open
Unresolved customer issue reviewed before expansion

rules.title: Resolve the person’s role
rules.next: An interview participant is not automatically a buyer. Keep contributor and customer records in separate workflows.

rules.title: Identify the research decision
rules.next: Ask what product, brand or customer decision the team needs to make and when it matters.

rules.title: Validate the signal
rules.next: A product launch or event interaction suggests a question; it does not prove budget or purchase intent.

rules.title: Clarify the research scope
rules.next: Record whether the team wants software, research support or both without promising a study outcome.

rules.title: Preserve the current customer relationship
rules.next: Route an existing customer’s new research need to the appropriate owner rather than a cold sequence.

rules.title: Address the customer issue first
rules.next: A new study signal should not hide an unresolved delivery or support concern.

ready.title: Ready for a research-decision review
ready.next: The account owner can clarify the decision, research scope and timing. Study design and findings remain separate from this commercial workflow.

experiments.name: Decision-led research discovery
experiments.hypothesis: A specific business decision makes outreach more relevant.
experiments.guardrail: Invented intent and unsupported study claims
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Customer-aware expansion signals
experiments.hypothesis: CS can act on new research needs when account health travels with the signal.
experiments.treatment: New decision plus relationship and issue context
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Define the research-buyer signal
roadmap.body: Work with Sales, Marketing and CS on buyer roles, research decisions and ownership boundaries.

roadmap.title: Pilot research and handoff automation
roadmap.body: Connect dated signals to an owned discovery brief, with explicit exceptions for participants and existing customers.

roadmap.title: Improve the full customer lifecycle
roadmap.body: Measure acquisition and repeat-study discovery separately. Expand the plays that produce useful conversations and customer value.
roadmap.measure: Qualified pipeline and CS-accepted research needs

records.name: Alder Consumer
records.context: A fictional team is testing a new product concept before launch.
records.question: Which decision should the research help the team make?

records.name: Cedar Interview Panel
records.context: An interview participant was added to a buyer audience.
records.question: Which role does this record actually represent?

records.name: Willow Product
records.context: The account brief mentions research but no business decision.
records.question: What decision and deadline make this work relevant?

records.name: Elm Brand
records.context: An undated campaign mention was treated as active purchase intent.
records.question: What does the current source support?

records.name: Birch Experience
records.context: An existing customer’s next study was routed to cold outbound.
records.question: Which CS or sales owner should receive the new need?

records.name: Juniper Insights
records.context: A new study request arrives alongside an unresolved support issue.
records.question: What should customer success resolve before expansion?

metricsTitle: Separate new demand from an existing customer’s next study.
metricsIntro: Invented weekly signal review with explicit relationship context.
metricsNotes: These numbers illustrate workflow measurement, not Strella research quality or commercial results.
Interview completion, customer insight and qualified sales opportunity are different outcomes.
Preserve participant roles and customer-support context before creating a new action.
